degree_method: d_ff and d_solv are measured with an in-house Boolean Macaulay-matrix profile (squarefree monomials, field equations built in). For D=d_min.. we form all multiples m*f_i with deg(m)+deg(f_i)<=D, rank r_D (random GF(2) column projection to rows+48 dims, exact M4RI rank, failure prob ~2^-48) and r_top (rank of degree-D block). Degree fall F_D = r_D - r_top - r_{D-1}; d_ff = first D with F_D>0. d_solv = first D with Q_D = dim P_{<=D} - r_D equal to the true number of Boolean solutions s (s by exhaustive enumeration over V^3 for l<=8, else not available -> d_solv censored). PolyBoRi groebner_basis()+variety() is used for the correctness control (planted solution recovered) for n<=19; PolyBoRi exposes no step degrees. Chained S_3 with the single intermediate abscissa u eliminated by resultant gives S_4 (m=3 needs one intermediate, not two; two would be m=4/S_5). No FGHR 4-torsion symmetrization (random curves, E[4] not rational): raw system.

fit.d_solv_method: d_ff extrapolation + mean(d_solv-d_ff) offset (fewer than 3 d_solv points)
